name: Methane Flue
description: Invisible but highly flammable natural gas has built up beneath the ground, where geological pressure can ignite it.
disable: DC 28 Survival check to dig around the vent in a way that diffuses the fumes

offensiveAbilities.name: Flame Spurt
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the flue

Effect A fiery geyser of flaming gas explodes from the ground. Creatures within 5 feet of the flue take 4d10 fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save); creatures that fail the save also take 4d10 persistent plus fire damage.
